headline: 🔴 TerminalFix fake CAPTCHA deploys reverse tunnels, 🎯 PaperCut second patch after bypass, 🏛️ ATF major incident confirmed, 💊 ShinyHunters claims 284M McKesson records, 🔧 ServiceNow critical RCE/SQLi, 📦 TanStack npm supply-chain worm
summary: TerminalFix emerges as a sophisticated ClickFix variant using fake Cloudflare CAPTCHAs to deploy reverse-tunnel implants, PaperCut issues a second emergency patch after the first was bypassed within a day, ATF confirms a major cyber incident linked to Qilin ransomware, and ShinyHunters claims one of the largest healthcare breaches on record with 284 million patient records from McKesson.
